speaker: narrator
text: What if a *gambler* suddenly owned the casino?

speaker: narrator
text: Jay has lost *everything* in this casino. Twice.

speaker: narrator
text: Then the old owner hands him *the keys*.

speaker: owner
text: It's yours, kid. Every table. Every *machine*.

speaker: hero
text: Wait. Why would you give it *away*?

speaker: owner
text: So *you* can find out how it works.

speaker: narrator
text: Day one. The new boss has *one plan*.

speaker: narrator
text: He sets every machine to *pay out*.

speaker: bit
text: Jay. We just lost *four million dollars*.

speaker: bit
text: Payroll is tomorrow. We have *eleven dollars*.

speaker: hero
text: Can we borrow money from the *casino*?

speaker: narrator
text: Then the phone rings. The old owner is *laughing*.
